solution.title: Architecture & Design Review Board (ARB) Governance Framework for a Workspace Transformation

products.name: Architecture & Design Review Board (ARB) Governance Framework for a Workspace Transformation — Commercial
products.short_description: Stand up an Architecture & Design Review Board for the transformation — charter, decision rights, review gates, templates, and drift prevention — so every major design is approved against the target architecture. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Give the transformation a decision authority that sticks

Large transformations drift when there's no forum with the authority to approve designs and stop bad ones. This solution stands up an Architecture & Design Review Board (ARB) for a Google Workspace + Gemini program: charter, decision rights, review gates, submission templates, and a design-drift-prevention process — so every major design decision is reviewed against the target architecture and vendor execution stays aligned to enterprise standards.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Governance Overview — the ARB's mandate, scope, and how it relates to the target architecture and the workstreams.
  • Charter & Decision Rights — membership, quorum, decision authority (who approves what), escalation, and the boundary between vendor execution and enterprise architectural authority.
  • Review Gates & Templates — the stage gates (migration wave plans, identity/sync models, security configs, data-migration patterns, work-transformation approaches), submission templates, review checklists, and decision records.
  • 5 supporting scripts — design-inventory discovery, conformance validation against approved standards, a decision/gap register report, safe remediation tracking, and a scope helper.
  • Drift-prevention process & a Design-Review-Board runbook — how to detect and stop unmanaged vendor-driven design drift, plus Testing gates and Best Practices.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every major design decision reviewed and approved against the target architecture — no unmanaged vendor-driven drift — with a governance forum that has real authority.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GWARB-Discovery.ps1 — inventory in-flight design decisions and their governance state
    • GWARB-Remediation.ps1 — open and assign remediation actions for each open drift/gap finding
    • GWARB-Report.ps1 — produce the decision/gap register and ARB throughput KPIs
    • GWARB-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create the ARB membership and reviewer groups in Entra
    • GWARB-Validation.ps1 — check submitted designs for conformance to the approved standards baseline

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
